_comment: Documented, reviewed false positives from the AgenticQA security scan. A finding is suppressed ONLY when a human has verified it is not a real vulnerability, with the reason recorded here. The scan-report script drops these before computing Status and the gate, so the table stops reporting verified-safe routes as FAIL. Removing an entry re-arms the finding. This is an allowlist of KNOWN-SAFE findings, never a way to hide unreviewed criticals.

suppressions.reason: Intentionally public build-version endpoint. Returns only the git SHA and Vercel deploy metadata so a push can be confirmed to have reached production. No DB, no secrets, no user data. Documented as public in the route header.

Authenticated via an x-ingest-token shared secret with a constant-time compare; returns 503 when the token is unconfigured and 401 on mismatch, rate-limited, accepts no PII. The scanner only recognizes the requireCapability gate as auth and does not model header-token auth.

This is a login endpoint: it mints an access token from {agent_id, onboarding_secret}. A login route cannot require a pre-existing auth token because the secret IS the credential. Rate-limited, anti-enumeration, audited. Equivalent to flagging /api/auth/login for having no auth check.
